restlet.description: Account-specific HTTPS RESTlet deployment URL. Prefer .config/supersuite.json.

realm.description: NetSuite account ID exactly as shown in Company Information (including sandbox suffix).

authType.description: TBA uses HMAC-SHA256. OAuth 2.0 uses an externally obtained access token stored in SecretStorage.

rootDirectory.description: Remote SuiteScripts folder corresponding to the workspace root.

batchSize.description: Maximum files per sequential transfer request.

maxBatchBytes.description: Maximum serialized upload request bytes; oversized files are reported separately.

exclude.description: Workspace-relative glob patterns excluded from folder transfers. Hidden paths, node_modules and private keys are always excluded.

metadataRecordTypes.description: Record type IDs to inspect when refreshing cached field completions.
